blocked_sentences: Station (Tap another creature you control: Put charge counters equal to its power on this Spacecraft. Station only as a sorcery. It's an artifact creature at 8+.)

needs.what: Station symbols (721) on keyword abilities: a `threshold: {counter: charge, at_least: 8}` that makes the permanent HAVE flying and vigilance only at 8+ charge counters, plus the Spacecraft rule that the permanent is an artifact creature with its printed P/T (7/7) only at its highest station threshold (8+) and a noncreature artifact below it
needs.why_existing_wont_do: Ability.threshold is accepted only on activated abilities (the packet notes: 'Activated abilities only'); a counters-conditioned grant_keyword static would leave the ability on the permanent, which the notes forbid for striations; and nothing gates the Spacecraft becoming a 7/7 artifact creature at 8+ -- a counters-conditioned set_types static would approximate rule 721 rather than implement station. The Station activation itself (tap_permanents with `as` + add_counters power_of) and the enters trigger are expressible, but the card is only partly expressible
